quality_semantics.eval_report: Measures TRAINING DATA quality: uses θ_opt directly from NPZ. Grade reflects VQE optimization quality, NOT MPNN prediction accuracy.
quality_semantics.comparison: Measures DEPLOYMENT quality: uses θ_pred from MPNN inference. Pass rate reflects end-to-end pipeline accuracy at test time.
quality_semantics.expected_gap: eval_report grade ≥ comparison pass_rate is NORMAL (training data is easier than generalization). Reverse (comparison > eval) suggests stale eval report.
